about_the_game:
Every run is a tight survival sprint that pushes combat skills, build choices, and map control. Zoom out for tactical awareness, then zoom in to third person view for precision headshots and clutch dodges. Swap between cinematic graphics and an optional pixel mode whenever you like. Die, learn, rebuild, repeat.

-Early test build

-One playable class

-One map with multiple bosses

-Curated pool of weapons, relics, and blessings

-Balance, audio, and performance still in progress

Key features

-Switch between top down and third person at any time

-Varied melee and ranged weapons with upgrades

-Six skill factions that change how you play

-Tight survival runs with rising pressure

-Draft perks and relics for high impact builds

-Boss fights that gate progress and reward skill

Why play the demo

-Feel the camera swap in real combat

-Try melee and gun builds across six paths

-Share feedback to shape the full release

Notes

-Controller and mouse keyboard supported

-Text and UI scale options included

-Demo progress may not carry over to the full game

-Work in progress content and balance subject to change

Enjoy the demo and wishlist the full game to follow updates!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10/11
  • Processor: i5-4670K @ 3.40GHz or similar
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce 970 or better
  • Storage: 4 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 3600 @ 3.60 GHz or similar
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce RTX 2060 or better
  • Storage: 4 MB available space

short_description: Dark Light: Survivor is a roguelike survival game set across post-apocalyptic ruins in a shattered multiverse consumed by the Dark Void. Switch between top down and third person views, blend melee and ranged builds, and channel six skill factions. Fight, adapt, and push for one more run.
